translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Hebreos
book.title: Kart daa bseḻ' to beṉ' lao beṉ' hebreoka', beṉ'ka' nonḻilall' Jesucrístona'

content: Daan, shlak ni de latj idoḻicho yeḻ' wixi'lallaa daa ba bc̱heb Chioza' goṉe' cho', chiyaḻ' goncho byen kwenc̱he idoḻ' illonichon na' ni tocho bi igaaṉzcho ka'z.
Ḻa' cho' ba benicho dill' wen dill' kob c̱he Chioza', ka daa beni dii x̱ozxto'choka'. Per ḻa'kzi bengakile'n, bi goklenan ḻegake' daa bi wyajḻe'gake' c̱heyin.
San cho' ba wyajḻe'cho c̱heyin ba nakten goṉ Chioza' cho' yeḻ' wixi'lallaa daa bllonile' beṉ'ka' kana' wne':

content.text: ṉezganz wi'a latj gaki c̱hegake' yeḻ' wixi'lall' c̱ha'na'.

content: Per ka nak Chioza', wzoloe' chizi'lallee ka biyoll bx̱e bsile' yell-lioni.
Ḻa' Cho'a Xtilleena' cho'en dill' c̱he lla gall llana', gana' nan:

content.text: Ka bllin lla gall llayina', ba biyoll ben Chioza' yog'ḻoḻ daa bene', na' bizi'lallee.

content: Na' ḻekzka' cho'en dill' kana' wne':

content.text: Ṉezganz wi'a latj gaki c̱hegake' yeḻ' wixi'lall' c̱ha'na'.

content: Per ni de latj gat' to yeḻ' wixi'lall' c̱he zi baḻ beṉ' cheeni, ḻa' beṉ'ka' bengakile' dii nech dill' wen c̱he Chioza' bi gok yillingake' gana' yizi'lall'gake' daa bi bzenaggake' c̱he'.
Daan, bllia Chioza' bia' c̱he sto lla, na' wde zan yiz wṉie' dii Davina' kwenc̱he wi'e dill' c̱he llani ṉaa, na' wne':

content.text: Shi chenile daa na Chioza' ṉaanlla,

content: Sheḻ' dii Josuéna' bene' ka yizi'lall' dii x̱ozxto'choka' ka bc̱heb Chioza' gone' c̱hegake', aga bllia Chioza' bia' sto lla yoblə gat' yeḻ' wixi'lall', sheḻ'ka'.
Daan, ṉezicho ni de latj idoḻ' beṉ'ka' nak lall' na' Chioza' yeḻ' wixi'lall' c̱he'na'.
Ḻa' beena' ba bdoḻi yeḻ' wixi'lallaa daa bc̱heb Chioza', ba chizi'lallee ka bizi'lall' Chioza' kana' biyoll bx̱e bsile' yog'ḻoḻ dii de.
Na' cho' chiyaḻ' goncho byen idoḻicho yeḻ' wixi'lallaa daa bc̱heb Chioza' kwenc̱he ni tocho bi gakcho beṉ' widenag ka gok beṉ'ka' kani'yi.

Na' cho'a xtill' Chioza' nsa'n yeḻ' mban na' yeḻ' wak, na' nakan ka to dii chc̱hogch aga ka to spad dii nḻatit c̱hop ḻaa. Ḻa' chazan ga zeelo ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'chona'. Na' chli'n lao daa chza'lall'cho ḻoo yic̱hjlall'do'chona' shi nakan wen wa shi nakan mal.
Ni to diika' bx̱e bsil Chioza' bi ngashaan lawe'na'. Yog'ḻoḻte ṉez nḻe'i beena' yizi'e cho' kwent.
Jesús, Xiiṉ Chioza', beena' billin yabana', nake' bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xen c̱hecho, na' daan chiyaḻ' soac̱hec̱hcho gonḻilall'cho beena' choe'cho xtilliinna'.
Na' bx̱oz choo bx̱oz xen c̱hechona' chiyesh'lallile' cho' daa nakcho beṉ' yell-lioz, ḻa' ḻekzka' btiḻe' daa nan kooyeḻaan ḻe' wx̱iṉj wḻene' ka chak c̱hecho, per ḻe', wzo wzakile' bi bx̱iṉj bḻene'.
Daan, do lall'cho chiyaḻ' ibig'cho xṉi'a Chioza', beena' chṉabia' na' nake' beṉ' chiyesh'lallii, kwenc̱he yizi'xene' c̱hecho na' gaklene' cho' kat' bittezə dii chak c̱hecho.
